headline: Whispering Fen Shrouded in Mist
summary: Beta council signals indicate strong satisfaction with core onboarding and exploration loops. To address feedback regarding mid-tier economic pacing and combat pressure, Whispering Fen is featured with increased coin rewards and heightened danger.

development_focus.title: Economy & Combat Density Balancing
development_focus.reason: Address tester observations regarding coin threshold gaps and sparse enemy encounters on high-difficulty routes.

experiment.reason: Boost route coin yields to help players bridge the gap toward high-tier cosmetic items.

challenge.title: Fen Pearl Expedition
challenge.description: Navigate the misty marsh of Whispering Fen and unearth hidden relics.

content_pack.title: Mist-Covered Bog Dangers
content_pack.description: Encounter denser bog thorns and elusive spirit whispers along the Whispering Fen path.

development_backlog.title: Implement Route Discovery Log UI
development_backlog.reason: Fulfills explorer feedback by adding an in-game tracking system for route collectibles and completion milestones.

development_backlog.title: Add Elite Enemy Profiles for Difficulty 3+ Routes
development_backlog.reason: Directly responds to combat challenger requests for higher risk and mechanical friction in advanced areas.

development_backlog.title: Introduce High-Contrast UI Theme Toggle
development_backlog.reason: Improves readability and meets accessibility requirements highlighted by UI/UX beta testers.

development_backlog.title: Refine Marketplace Pacing and Wishlist Progress
development_backlog.reason: Smoothes out the coin threshold gap between standard cosmetics and premium crown items.

development_backlog.title: Add Explicit Input Buffering Feedback for Obstacles
development_backlog.reason: Helps edge-case testers distinguish between input lag and path blocking from static hazards.
